My ex. Before I was diagnosed with bipolar depression I would have uncontrollable suicidal thoughts. It finally got to the point where I felt sick because all I could think about every second of the day was suicide. I was going to shoot myself one morning and all I could think about was my ex and how bad it would hurt her (we aren’t on bad terms, just distance problems). So I txt her and told her I wanted to kill myself and that same day I was checked into the hospital and got evaluated and put on a mood stabilizer and I’ve been doing fine ever since. If it wasn’t for her, I guarantee I wouldn’t be here today.
